Maria: Morning y'all — absolute monsoon at my place, BART showing 20-30m delays inbound. Anyone stuck? :umbrella_with_rain_drops:
Ashwin: I'm on 280 heading to the office, traffic is a parking lot. Can probably be 45m.
Jon: @Maria I'm stuck at Fruitvale, they just announced single-tracking. Ferry canceled this morning between Larkspur and SF :frowning: 
TransitBot: BART status: Delays 20-30 mins between Embarcadero and MacArthur due to signal problems. Caltrain: minor delays. (https://status.bart.gov)
Devon: Working from home today, my bike got a river down the street. If anyone needs a spare umbrella, I have one at the market entrance.
Keisha: Thanks @Devon — I might take you up on that. Also FYI Shields lot is flooded, don't park there.
Ashwin: Heads up for folks on the 38R — bus detours, add 15-20.
Jon: If anyone wants to coordinate a single commute meetup to split an Uber, react with :hand: 
Maria: :hand: leaving at 11am if the BART doesn't clear. Ping me in #random if you're near Embarcadero.
Devon: @Jon I'll go half on an Uber if needed. Keep safe everyone. :heart: 
Keisha: Reminder: if you can't make it in, mark OOO for the morning and ping your manager. No one expects you to brave the roads for a standup.
TransitBot: Ferry status: Larkspur-SF canceled due to high winds. Another update in 35m.
Ashwin: ETA home update — slow crawl but moving. Coffee is my new co-pilot.
Maria: Thanks for the check-ins. Appreciate the umbrella offer @Devon. I'll stay WFH until this clears.
Jon: Meme: "Bay Area weather in one week": sunny, fog, storm, repeat. :sweat_smile: 
Keisha: Pictures welcome but please don't post car carnage pics in #random. Keep it PG :grimacing: 
TransitBot: Next scheduled update 1728800299.
